svg.title: Classifieds: the tools of the trade
svg.desc: A newspaper classifieds page listing the tech stack. AI & LLMs: Claude, Claude Code, MCP, OpenAI, Codex, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, LangChain, Hugging Face, NotebookLM. Voice: Vapi, Twilio, ElevenLabs, Deepgram, Retell AI. Phone agents that book, qualify and take payments. Machine learning: PyTorch, scikit-learn, LightGBM, XGBoost, ONNX, NumPy, pandas, OpenCV, Jupyter, Colab. Backend: Python, FastAPI, Flask, Node.js, NestJS, Express, Prisma, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, Neon, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Stripe, Resend. Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Astro, Streamlit, better-auth. Infra & automation: Docker, Kubernetes, NGINX, Prometheus, GitHub Actions, GHCR, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, MinIO, Linux, Bash, n8n, Playwright, Jest.
